state.paragraph: On September 21, 2013, the members of the Transaction Committee called the representative of CSC/Pamplona to propose that Mac-Gray was prepared to move forward with CSC/Pamplona on an exclusive basis for two weeks subject to CSC/Pamplona increasing their all-cash purchase price to $21.25 per share. Later that same day, the representative of CSC/Pamplona called the members of the Transaction Committee to confirm that CSC/Pamplona were willing to increase their all-cash purchase price to $21.25 per share as a last and best offer, provided that Mac-Gray agree to a two week period of exclusive negotiations. The representative of CSC/Pamplona also requested that shares of Mac-Gray common stock owned beneficially and of record by Mr. MacDonald and his immediate family be subject to a customary voting agreement, which we refer to as the MacDonald voting agreements.
state.target_sentence: On September 21, 2013, the members of the Transaction Committee called the representative of CSC/Pamplona to propose that Mac-Gray was prepared to move forward with CSC/Pamplona on an exclusive basis for two weeks subject to CSC/Pamplona increasing their all-cash purchase price to $21.25 per share.

criteria.row_36: 09/18/2013 | CSC/Pamplona | Bid | price 20.75 | Final-round proposal, up from $19.50 (#28); Formal as a response to the final solicitation. Pamplona commits 100% of the capital; only confirmatory diligence followed (Light). Requests 2-week exclusivity.
criteria.row_37: 09/18/2013 | Party A | Bid reaffirmed | price 18-19 | By phone to BofA: confirms #31 as its best and final offer, answering the final solicitation. The 09/10 bid had no firm financing commitment and none is reported since (Heavy).
criteria.row_38: 09/18/2013 | Party B | Bid | price 21.5 | Party B values its bid at $21.50: $19.00 cash plus options for 10% of new equity, which it values at $2.50 and which vest on a five-year target. Debt-and-equity financing, no commitment reported (Heavy).
criteria.row_39: 09/18/2013 | Party C | Did not submit | Did not submit or reaffirm its $16.00-$17.00 IOI (#32) and gave no reason. Reported on 09/19; not seen again.
criteria.row_41: 09/19/2013 | Mac-Gray (Special Committee) | Other material event | Preferred bidder and price requirement: CSC/Pamplona is best on value, certainty and risk (Party B's options and financing riskier). Exclusivity offered at $21.25; MacDonald supports $21.25.
criteria.row_42: 09/21/2013 | CSC/Pamplona | Bid | price 21.25 | Raised from $20.75 (#35) the same day the committee asked. Conditioned on 2-week exclusivity; asks for voting agreements from MacDonald. Pamplona funds 100%, no financing contingency; confirmatory diligence only (Light).
criteria.row_43: 09/24/2013 | CSC/Pamplona | Exclusivity changed | Executed, authorized 09/23; exclusive until 5 p.m. 10/12/2013. Ends if CSC/Pamplona adversely changes the $21.25 final proposal. CSC/Pamplona then got full data-room access.
criteria.row_44: by 09/24/2013 | Party A | Dropped by target | Inferred: displaced when exclusivity with CSC/Pamplona was executed; not reported told. On 09/18 it declined to improve its $18.00-$19.00 range (#36).
criteria.row_45: by 09/24/2013 | Party B | Dropped by target | Inferred date: displaced by exclusivity with CSC/Pamplona. Reason from the committee on 09/19: Party B's options were contingent and deferred, and its financing riskier, despite the higher face value.
criteria.none: None of the ledger rows records the event reported in the target sentence, either as the row's own event or in its note.
criteria.not_an_event: The target sentence reports no discrete event of these kinds (background, reasoning, description or discussion only).

match.instructions: `target_sentence` (from a merger filing; `paragraph` gives context) appears to report that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted; or exclusivity is requested, authorised, granted, signed or extended. Each option describes one row of a research ledger as date | party | event | note. Select the row that records the event reported in `target_sentence`: same party or group, same action, consistent date and terms, allowing paraphrase and allowing the event to be summarised in a row's note. A related event with a different party, date or action does not count.
